description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams' used for filtering employee dependents in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as 'name', 'empNumber', and 'relationshipType' along with their getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for specifying search filter parameters related to employee dependents within HRM queries. It includes fields for name, employee number, and relationship type, with appropriate getter/setter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'd.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter criteria.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type filter criteria.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type filter criterion.
